\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item \&\#8203;Change the CSS class prefix to {\ttfamily base-\/} (\#40205) @michaldudak
\end{DoxyItemize}

The class prefix of Base \+UI components have been changed from {\ttfamily Mui-\/} to {\ttfamily base-\/}. This only affects codebases that uses class names verbatim, i.\+e. not exposed by JS objects such as {\ttfamily button\+Classes}, but as plain strings or in CSS stylesheets ({\ttfamily .Mui\+Button.\+root})

To adapt your code to the new pattern\+:


\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item replace all occurrences of the regex {\ttfamily .Mui(\mbox{[}A-\/Z\mbox{]}\mbox{[}A-\/\+Za-\/z\mbox{]}\texorpdfstring{$\ast$}{*})-\/} with {\ttfamily .base-\/\$1-\/} (so {\ttfamily Mui\+Button-\/root} becomes {\ttfamily base-\/\+Button-\/root}, etc.),
\item replace all occurrences of the regex {\ttfamily .Mui-\/(\mbox{[}a-\/z\mbox{]}\texorpdfstring{$\ast$}{*})} with {\ttfamily .base-\/-\/\$1} (so {\ttfamily Mui-\/disabled} becomes {\ttfamily base-\/-\/disabled}, etc.).
\end{DoxyItemize}\hypertarget{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md5328}{}\doxysubsubsection{\texorpdfstring{Changes}{Changes}}\label{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md5328}

\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item \&\#8203;\mbox{[}base\mbox{]} Ban default exports (\#38200) @michaldudak

Base \+UI default exports were changed to named ones. Previously we had a mix of default and named ones. This was changed to improve consistency and avoid problems some bundlers have with default exports. See \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/issues/21862}{\texttt{https\+://github.\+com/mui/material-\/ui/issues/21862}} for more context.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ import\ Button,\ \{\ buttonClasses\ \}\ from\ '@mui/base/Button';}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ import\ \{\ Button,\ buttonClasses\ \}\ from\ '@mui/base/Button';}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ import\ BaseMenu\ from\ '@mui/base/Menu';}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ import\ \{\ Menu\ as\ BaseMenu\ \}\ from\ '@mui/base/Menu';}

\end{DoxyCode}


Additionally, the {\ttfamily Class\+Name\+Generator} has been moved to the directory matching its name\+:


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ import\ ClassNameGenerator\ from\ '@mui/base/className';}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ import\ \{\ ClassNameGenerator\ \}\ from\ '@mui/base/ClassNameGenerator';}

\end{DoxyCode}


A codemod is provided to help with the migration\+:


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{npx\ @mui/codemod@latest\ v5.0.0/base-\/use-\/named-\/exports\ <path>}

\end{DoxyCode}

\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item The {\ttfamily component} prop is no longer supported because it can be replaced with the slots API. This is how the transformation will look like\+:


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ <Button}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ component="{}span"{}}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ slots=\{\{\ root:\ "{}span"{}\ \}\}}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ />}

\end{DoxyCode}


If using Type\+Script, the custom component type should be added as a generic on the {\ttfamily Button} component.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/<Button}
\DoxyCodeLine{+<Button<typeof\ CustomComponent>}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ slots=\{\{\ root:\ CustomComponent\ \}\}}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ customProp="{}foo"{}}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ />}

\end{DoxyCode}


There is codemod that you can run in your project to do the transformation\+:


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{npx\ @mui/codemod@latest\ v5.0.0/base-\/remove-\/component-\/prop\ <path>}

\end{DoxyCode}


The full documentation about the codemod can be found \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/blob/master/packages/mui-codemod/README.md\#base-remove-component-prop}{\texttt{here}}.

Brought consistency to Base \+UI components and hooks\textquotesingle{} parameters and return values\+:
\begin{DoxyEnumerate}
\item Whenever a hook needs a ref, it\textquotesingle{}s now called {\ttfamily \texorpdfstring{$<$}{<}slot\+\_\+name\texorpdfstring{$>$}{>}Ref}, which matches the {\ttfamily get\texorpdfstring{$<$}{<}slot\+\_\+name\texorpdfstring{$>$}{>}Props} in the return value.
\item All hooks that accept external refs now return merged refs, making combining multiple hooks on one element easier. This was proven necessary in several compound components (like menu\+Item being both a button and a list item). The type of this value is {\ttfamily React.\+Ref\+Callback} as using the more general {\ttfamily React.\+Ref} caused variance issues.
\item Type of accepted refs is standardized to {\ttfamily React.\+Ref\texorpdfstring{$<$}{<}Element\texorpdfstring{$>$}{>}}
\item Naming and typing of the forwarded ref in unstyled components were standardized -\/ it\textquotesingle{}s forwarded\+Ref\+: React.\+Forwarded\+Ref$<$\+Element$>$ (unless a more specific type is needed).
\item The shape of the definition of unstyled components was standardized -\/ it\textquotesingle{}s React.\+forward\+Ref(function Component(props\+: Props, forwarded\+Ref\+: React.\+Ref$<$\+Element$>$) \{ ... \});. Specifically, the generic parameters of forward\+Ref were removed as they are specified in function arguments.
\end{DoxyEnumerate}
\end{DoxyItemize}\hypertarget{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md5599}{}\doxysubsubsection{\texorpdfstring{Changes}{Changes}}\label{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md5599}

\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item \&\#8203;\mbox{[}base\mbox{]} Refactor the compound components building blocks (\#36400) @michaldudak Components affected by the changes are\+:
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item Menu
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item {\ttfamily Menu\+Unstyled\+Context} is replaced by {\ttfamily Menu\+Provider}. The value to pass to the provider is returned by the {\ttfamily use\+Menu} hook.
\item Menu\+Unstyled\textquotesingle{}s {\ttfamily on\+Close} prop is replaced by {\ttfamily on\+Open\+Change}. It has the {\ttfamily open} parameter and is called when a menu is opened or closed
\end{DoxyItemize}
\item Select
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item {\ttfamily Select\+Unstyled\+Context} is replaced by {\ttfamily Select\+Provider}. The value to pass to the provider is returned by the {\ttfamily use\+Select} hook.
\item {\ttfamily Select\+Unstyled}\textquotesingle{}s popup is permanently mounted.
\item The {\ttfamily default\+Open} prop was added to the Select\+Unstyled. The open/close state can now be controlled or uncontrolled, as a {\ttfamily value}.
\end{DoxyItemize}
\item Tabs
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item {\ttfamily Tabs\+Context} is replaced by {\ttfamily Tabs\+Provider}. The value to pass to the provider is returned by the {\ttfamily use\+Tabs} hook.
\item To deselect all tabs, pass in {\ttfamily null} to Tabs\textquotesingle{} {\ttfamily value} prop, instead of {\ttfamily false}. This is consistent with how Select works.
\item The {\ttfamily value} prop is still technically not mandatory on Tab\+Unstyled and Tab\+Panel, but when omitted, the contents of the selected tab panel will not be rendered during SSR.
\end{DoxyItemize}
\end{DoxyItemize}
\end{DoxyItemize}\hypertarget{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md5617}{}\doxysubsection{\texorpdfstring{{\ttfamily @mui/joy@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+76}}{{\ttfamily @mui/joy@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+76}}}\label{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md5617}

Below is an example of how the migration should look like\+:    @icode\{diff\}     import \{       unstable\+\_\+create\+Css\+Vars\+Provider as create\+Css\+Vars\+Provider,   +   unstable\+\_\+create\+Css\+Vars\+Theme as create\+Css\+Vars\+Theme,    \} from \textquotesingle{}@mui/system\textquotesingle{};   @endicode     Or you can define it directly in the theme prop\+:    @icode\{diff\}     $<$\+Css\+Vars\+Provider   +   theme=\{create\+Css\+Vars\+Provider(\{   +    // other theme keys   +    should\+Skip\+Generating\+Var\+: (keys) =$>$ keys\mbox{[}0\mbox{]} === \textquotesingle{}typography\textquotesingle{} \&\& keys\mbox{[}1\mbox{]} === \textquotesingle{}h1\textquotesingle{}   +   \})\} /$>$   @endicode     This breaking change $<$strong$>$only$<$/strong$>$ affects experimental APIs  @subsection autotoc\+\_\+md5656 $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}@mui/base\textbackslash{}@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+120$<$/tt$>$  @subsubsection autotoc\+\_\+md5657 Breaking changes  -\/ \&\#8203;\mbox{[}\+Select\mbox{]}\mbox{[}base\mbox{]} Add the multiselect functionality to Select\+Unstyled (\#36274) @michaldudak    The Multi\+Select\+Unstyled was removed. Here are some highlights ✨\+:  -\/ 🛠 @goncalovf added an example project using $<$a href="{}\href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/tree/master/examples/material-ui-vite}{\texttt{https\+://github.\+com/mui/material-\/ui/tree/master/examples/material-\/ui-\/vite}}"{} $>$\+Material \+UI with Vite.\+js$<$/a$>$ (\#28241) -\/ Number of 🐛 bug fixes and 📚 documentation improvements.  @subsection autotoc\+\_\+md6080 $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}@mui/material\textbackslash{}@5.\+4.\+0$<$/tt$>$  @subsubsection autotoc\+\_\+md6081 Breaking changes  -\/ \&\#8203;\mbox{[}core\mbox{]} Do not reexport Base from Material (\#30853) @michaldudak    All Base components were exported from the $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}@mui/material$<$/tt$>$ package and treated as stable even though the $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}@mui/base$<$/tt$>$ package is in development. It could create a lot of confusion if developers start using Base components, depend on them, and demand quality found in "{}proper"{} Material components. We admit it was a mistake to reexport these components without marking them as unstable.    Developers are still encouraged to evaluate the Base components, but they should do so by explicitly installing the $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}@mui/base$<$/tt$>$ package.    This is technically a breaking change as it removes a number of components from the $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}@mui/material$<$/tt$>$ package. However, we believe that removing the components now and potentially breaking the codebases will do less harm than introducing "{}silent"{} breaking changes to Base components while continuing reexporting them from $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}@mui/material$<$/tt$>$.    Note\+: the utility components, such as Click\+Away\+Listener, No\+Ssr, Portal, and Textarea\+Autosize continue to be exported from both $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}@mui/material$<$/tt$>$ and $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}@mui/base$<$/tt$>$.    If you\textquotesingle{}re encountering build errors after upgrading @mui/material, do the following\+:    1. Install @mui/base\+: npm install @mui/base or yarn add @mui/base   2. Make sure the version of @mui/base match the version of @mui/material   3. Change the import paths of unstyled components from @mui/material to @mui/base, e.\+g.\+:    @icode\{diff\}    -\/import Button\+Unstyled from \textquotesingle{}@mui/material/\+Button\+Unstyled\textquotesingle{};   +import Button\+Unstyled from \textquotesingle{}@mui/base/\+Button\+Unstyled\textquotesingle{};   @endicode   @subsubsection The main rationale for this is the fact that we use the term "{}Core"{} to refer to the core components product family, the one that includes Material Design components, unstyled components, System utilities, etc. Therefore, @mui/core was effectively a subset of MUI \+Core. This was confusing. {\itshape Jul 01, 2021}

A big thanks to the 13 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:


\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 🎉 This is the first beta release of v5! A huge thanks to everyone who helped to make this happen! We\textquotesingle{}re targeting the 1st of September for a stable release, and will use the next two months to polish v5, and ease the migration from v4. You can follow \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/milestone/44}{\texttt{the v5 stable milestone}} for more details. We now encourage any new projects to start on v5.
\item 🚀 We have completed all the planned breaking changes.
\item ⚒️ We added the codemod CLI to simplify migration to v5 (\#26941) @eps1lon. You can find it at \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/tree/HEAD/packages/mui-codemod}{\texttt{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/codemod}}}.
\item 🐛 The majority of other changes in this release were bug fixes, test utilities and docs.
\end{DoxyItemize}\hypertarget{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6287}{}\doxysubsection{\texorpdfstring{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core@5.\+0.\+0-\/beta.\+0}}{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core@5.\+0.\+0-\/beta.\+0}}}\label{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6287}

{\itshape Jun 23, 2021}

A big thanks to the 18 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:


\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 🚀 We have only 2 left in the \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/issues/20012}{\texttt{breaking changes}}. The plan to release 5.\+0.\+0-\/beta.\+0 is on July 1st and will start to promote its usage over v4.
\item 🎨 We have updated {\ttfamily Slider} to match current \href{https://m2.material.io/components/sliders}{\texttt{Material Design guidelines}}.

\href{https://mui.com/components/slider/\#continuous-sliders}{\texttt{}}
\item 💡 {\ttfamily Icon\+Button} now supports 3 sizes ({\ttfamily small, medium, large}). \href{https://mui.com/components/buttons/\#sizes-2}{\texttt{See demo}}.
\item ♿️ We have improved the default style of the {\ttfamily Link} to be more accessible (\#26145) @ahmed-\/28

\href{https://mui.com/components/links/}{\texttt{}}
\end{DoxyItemize}\hypertarget{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6299}{}\doxysubsection{\texorpdfstring{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+38}}{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+38}}}\label{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6299}
\hypertarget{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6300}{}\doxysubsubsection{\texorpdfstring{Breaking changes}{Breaking changes}}\label{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6300}

\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item \&\#8203;\mbox{[}Menu\mbox{]} Use Button\+Base in Menu\+Item (\#26591) @siriwatknp
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item Change the default value of {\ttfamily anchor\+Origin.\+vertical} to follow the Material Design guidelines. The menu now displays below the anchor instead of on top of it. You can restore the previous behavior with\+:


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ <Menu}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ anchorOrigin=\{\{}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ \ \ vertical:\ 'top',}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ \ \ horizontal:\ 'left',}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ \}\}}

\end{DoxyCode}

\item The {\ttfamily Menu\+Item} component inherits the {\ttfamily Button\+Base} component instead of {\ttfamily List\+Item}. The class names related to "{}\+Mui\+List\+Item-\/\textbackslash{}\texorpdfstring{$\ast$}{*}"{} are removed and theming {\ttfamily List\+Item} is no longer affecting {\ttfamily Menu\+Item}.

{\ttfamily diff -\/\texorpdfstring{$<$}{<}li class\+Name="{}\+Mui\+Button\+Base-\/root Mui\+Menu\+Item-\/root Mui\+List\+Item-\/root"{}\texorpdfstring{$>$}{>} +\texorpdfstring{$<$}{<}li class\+Name="{}\+Mui\+Button\+Base-\/root Mui\+Menu\+Item-\/root"{}\texorpdfstring{$>$}{>} }
\item The prop {\ttfamily list\+Item\+Classes} was removed, you can use {\ttfamily classes} instead.

{\ttfamily diff -\/\texorpdfstring{$<$}{<}Menu\+Item list\+Item\+Classes=\{\{...\}\}\texorpdfstring{$>$}{>} +\texorpdfstring{$<$}{<}Menu\+Item classes=\{\{...\}\}\texorpdfstring{$>$}{>} }
\end{DoxyItemize}
\item \&\#8203;\mbox{[}theme\mbox{]} Improve default breakpoints (\#26746) @siriwatknp

The default breakpoints were changed to better match the common use cases. They also better match the Material Design guidelines. \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/issues/21902}{\texttt{Read more about the change}}.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \{}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ xs:\ 0,}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ sm:\ 600,}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ md:\ 960,}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ md:\ 900,}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ lg:\ 1280,}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ lg:\ 1200,}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ xl:\ 1920,}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ xl:\ 1536,}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \}}

\end{DoxyCode}


If you prefer the old breakpoint values, use the snippet below.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{import\ \{\ createTheme\ \}\ from\ '@material-\/ui/core/styles';}
\DoxyCodeLine{}
\DoxyCodeLine{const\ theme\ =\ createTheme(\{}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ breakpoints:\ \{}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ \ values:\ \{}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ \ \ \ xs:\ 0,}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ \ \ \ sm:\ 600,}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ \ \ \ md:\ 960,}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ \ \ \ lg:\ 1280,}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ \ \ \ xl:\ 1920,}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ \ \},}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \},}
\DoxyCodeLine{\});}

\end{DoxyCode}

\item \&\#8203;\mbox{[}Icon\+Button\mbox{]} Add size {\ttfamily large} and update styles (\#26748) @siriwatknp

The default size\textquotesingle{}s padding is reduced to {\ttfamily 8px} which makes the default Icon\+Button size of {\ttfamily 40px}. To get the old default size ({\ttfamily 48px}), use {\ttfamily size="{}large"{}}. The change was done to better match Google\textquotesingle{}s products when Material Design stopped documenting the icon button pattern.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ <IconButton>}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ <IconButton\ size="{}large"{}>}

\end{DoxyCode}

\item \&\#8203;\mbox{[}Slider\mbox{]} Adjust css to match the specification (\#26632) @siriwatknp

Rework the CSS to match the latest \href{https://m2.material.io/components/sliders}{\texttt{Material Design guidelines}} and make custom styles more intuitive. \href{https://mui.com/components/slider/}{\texttt{See documentation}}.

\href{https://mui.com/components/slider/\#continuous-sliders}{\texttt{}}

You can reduce the density of the slider, closer to v4 with the \href{https://mui.com/components/slider/\#sizes}{\texttt{{\ttfamily size="{}small"{}} prop}}.

\href{https://mui.com/components/slider/\#sizes}{\texttt{}}
\item \&\#8203;\mbox{[}Icon\+Button\mbox{]} Remove label span (\#26801) @siriwatknp

{\ttfamily span} element that wraps children has been removed. {\ttfamily label} class\+Key is also removed. More details about \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/pull/26666}{\texttt{this change}}.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ <button\ class="{}MuiIconButton-\/root"{}>}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ <span\ class="{}MuiIconButton-\/label"{}>}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ \ \ <svg\ />}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ </span>}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ </button>}

\end{DoxyCode}

\item \&\#8203;\mbox{[}core\mbox{]} Remove {\ttfamily unstable\+\_\+} prefix on the {\ttfamily use\+Theme\+Props} hook (\#26777) @mnajdova

The following utilities were renamed to not contain the {\ttfamily unstable\+\_\+} prefix\+:

\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ useThemeProps,}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \}\ from\ '@material-\/ui/core/styles';}

\end{DoxyCode}

{\itshape Jun 15, 2021}

A big thanks to the 11 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:


\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 💄 Add support for responsive props on the Grid component (\#26590) @likitarai1. This fixes a longstanding issue. You can now specify different values for each breakpoint.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{<Grid\ container\ spacing=\{\{\ xs:\ 2,\ md:\ 3\ \}\}\ columns=\{\{\ xs:\ 1,\ sm:\ 2,\ md:\ 3\ \}\}>}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ <Grid\ item\ xs=\{2\}\ sm=\{4\}\ md=\{4\}\ />}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ <Grid\ item\ xs=\{2\}\ sm=\{4\}\ md=\{4\}\ />}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ <Grid\ item\ xs=\{2\}\ sm=\{4\}\ md=\{4\}\ />}
\DoxyCodeLine{</Grid>}

\end{DoxyCode}


Head to the \href{https://mui.com/components/grid/\#responsive-values}{\texttt{documentation}} for more details.
\item ⚒️ We\textquotesingle{}ve introduced a new {\ttfamily use\+Theme} and {\ttfamily use\+Theme\+Props} hooks in the {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/system} package. We believe that this package can be used as a standalone styling solution for building custom design systems (\#26649) @mnajdova.
\item 💥 Made progress with the breaking changes. We have done 105 of the 109 changes \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/issues/20012}{\texttt{planned}}. We are getting closer to our goal of releasing 5.\+0.\+0-\/beta.\+0 on July 1st and start to promote its usage over v4. You can also follow \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/milestone/35}{\texttt{our milestone}} for more details.
\item And many more 🐛 bug fixes and 📚 improvements.
\end{DoxyItemize}\hypertarget{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6308}{}\doxysubsection{\texorpdfstring{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+37}}{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+37}}}\label{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6308}

{\itshape Jun 8, 2021}

A big thanks to the 14 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:


\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item ⚒️ We\textquotesingle{}ve introduced a new {\ttfamily List\+Item\+Button} component that should prevent common mistakes when using {\ttfamily \texorpdfstring{$<$}{<}List\+Item button /\texorpdfstring{$>$}{>}} and help with customization and Type\+Script support (\#26446) @siriwatknp.
\item 👩‍🎤 {\ttfamily experimental\+Styled} is now available without the {\ttfamily experimental} prefix. We\textquotesingle{}re confident that its API shouldn\textquotesingle{}t receive any major changes until the stable release of v5 (\#26558) @mnajdova.
\item 📦 {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/icons} only ships ES modules and no longer Common\+JS modules. This reduces the download size of the package from 1.\+7 MB to 1.\+2 MB and install size from 15.\+6 MB to 6.\+7 MB (\#26310) @eps1lon.
\item 💄 Add support for \href{https://mui.com/components/grid/\#row-amp-column-spacing}{\texttt{row and column spacing}} in the Grid component (\#26559) @likitarai1. 

Note that this feature was already available for \href{https://mui.com/components/grid/\#css-grid-layout}{\texttt{CSS grid users}} with the {\ttfamily row\+Gap} and {\ttfamily column\+Gap} props.
\end{DoxyItemize}\hypertarget{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6320}{}\doxysubsection{\texorpdfstring{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+36}}{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+36}}}\label{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6320}

\item \&\#8203;\mbox{[}App\+Bar\mbox{]} Fix background color on dark mode (\#26545) @siriwatknp

The {\ttfamily color} prop has no longer any effect in dark mode. The app bar uses the background color required by the elevation to follow the \href{https://m2.material.io/design/color/dark-theme.html}{\texttt{Material Design guidelines}}. Use {\ttfamily enable\+Color\+On\+Dark} to restore the behavior of v4.

{\itshape May 31, 2021}

A big thanks to the 14 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:


\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 👩‍🎤 We have completed the migration to emotion of all the components ({\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core} and {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/lab}) @siriwatknp, @mnajdova.
\item 📦 Save \href{https://bundlephobia.com/package/@material-ui/core@5.0.0-alpha.34}{\texttt{10 kB gzipped}} by removing the dependency on {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/styles} (JSS) from the core and the lab (\#26377, \#26382, \#26376) @mnajdova.
\item ⚒️ Add many new \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/blob/v5.0.0/packages/mui-codemod/README.md}{\texttt{codemods}} to automate the migration from v4 to v5 (\#24867) @mbrookes.
\item And many more 🐛 bug fixes and 📚 improvements.
\end{DoxyItemize}\hypertarget{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6331}{}\doxysubsection{\texorpdfstring{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+35}}{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+35}}}\label{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6331}

\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item \mbox{[}styles\mbox{]} Remove {\ttfamily make\+Styles} from {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core} (\#26382) @mnajdova

The {\ttfamily make\+Styles} JSS utility is no longer exported from {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core}. You can use {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/styles} instead. Make sure to add a {\ttfamily Theme\+Provider} at the root of your application, as the {\ttfamily default\+Theme} is no longer available. If you are using this utility together with {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core}, it\textquotesingle{}s recommended you use the {\ttfamily Theme\+Provider} component from {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core} instead.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}

\DoxyCodeLine{+import\ \{\ makeStyles\ \}\ from\ '@material-\/ui/styles';}
\DoxyCodeLine{+import\ \{\ createTheme,\ ThemeProvider\ \}\ from\ '@material-\/ui/core/styles';}
\DoxyCodeLine{}
\DoxyCodeLine{+const\ theme\ =\ createTheme();}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ const\ useStyles\ =\ makeStyles((theme)\ =>\ (\{}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ background:\ theme.palette.primary.main,}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \}));}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ function\ Component()\ \{}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ const\ classes\ =\ useStyles();}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ return\ <div\ className=\{classes.root\}\ />}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \}}
\DoxyCodeLine{}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ //\ In\ the\ root\ of\ your\ app}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ function\ App(props)\ \{}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ return\ <Component\ />;}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ return\ <ThemeProvider\ theme=\{theme\}><Component\ \{...props\}\ /></ThemeProvider>;}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \}}

\end{DoxyCode}

\item \mbox{[}styles\mbox{]} Remove {\ttfamily with\+Styles} from {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core} (\#26377) @mnajdova

The {\ttfamily with\+Styles} JSS utility is no longer exported from {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core}. You can use {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/styles} instead. Make sure to add a {\ttfamily Theme\+Provider} at the root of your application, as the {\ttfamily default\+Theme} is no longer available. If you are using this utility together with {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core}, you should use the {\ttfamily Theme\+Provider} component from {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core} instead.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/import\ \{\ withStyles\ \}\ from\ '@material-\/ui/core/styles';}

\DoxyCodeLine{}

\DoxyCodeLine{}

\DoxyCodeLine{\ \}}

\end{DoxyCode}

\item \mbox{[}styles\mbox{]} Merge options in {\ttfamily experimental\+Styled} (\#26396) @mnajdova

The options inside the {\ttfamily experimental\+Styled} module are now merged under one object. In the coming weeks, we will rename ths module\+: {\ttfamily styled()} to signal that it\textquotesingle{}s no longer experimental.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}

\end{DoxyCode}

\item \mbox{[}Tabs\mbox{]} Update {\ttfamily min} \& {\ttfamily max} width and remove {\ttfamily min\+Width} media query (\#26458) @siriwatknp

Update the implementation to better match Material Design\+:
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item Tab {\ttfamily min\+Width} changed from {\ttfamily 72px} =\texorpdfstring{$>$}{>} {\ttfamily 90px} (without media-\/query) according to \href{https://m2.material.io/components/tabs\#specs}{\texttt{material-\/design spec}}
\item Tab {\ttfamily max\+Width} changed from {\ttfamily 264px} =\texorpdfstring{$>$}{>} {\ttfamily 360px} according to \href{https://m2.material.io/components/tabs\#specs}{\texttt{material-\/design spec}}
\end{DoxyItemize}

{\itshape May 18, 2021}

A big thanks to the 16 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:


\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 💥 Make progress with the breaking changes. We have done 89 of the 109 changes \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/issues/20012}{\texttt{planned}}. We will release 5.\+0.\+0-\/beta.\+0 on July 1st and start to promote its usage over v4. You can also follow \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/milestone/35}{\texttt{our milestone}} for more details.

{\bfseries{with\+Styles}}

Replace the {\ttfamily inner\+Ref} prop with the {\ttfamily ref} prop. Refs are now automatically forwarded to the inner component.

\end{DoxyCode}


{\bfseries{with\+Theme}}

Replace the {\ttfamily inner\+Ref} prop with the {\ttfamily ref} prop. Refs are now automatically forwarded to the inner component.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}

Developers only need one theme in their application. A prefix would suggest a second theme is needed. It\textquotesingle{}s not the case. {\ttfamily create\+Mui\+Theme} will be removed in v6.

The {\ttfamily styled} {\bfseries{JSS}} utility is no longer exported from {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core/styles}. You can use {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/styles/styled} instead. Make sure to add a {\ttfamily Theme\+Provider} at the root of your application, as the {\ttfamily default\+Theme} is no longer available. If you are using this utility together with {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core}, it\textquotesingle{}s recommended you use the {\ttfamily Theme\+Provider} component from {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core/styles} instead.

\DoxyCodeLine{+<Box\ component="{}button"{}\ sx=\{\{\ display:\ \{\ xs:\ 'none',\ md:\ 'block'\ \}\ \}\}\ />}

Use the {\ttfamily use\+Media\+Query} hook to replace {\ttfamily implementation="{}js"{}}\+:


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}

{\itshape Apr 27, 2021}

A big thanks to the 15 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:


\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 👩‍🎤 We have completed the migration to emotion of all components in {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core}. We will focus on the components in {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/lab} next.
\item 💥 Make progress with the breaking changes plan. We have done 38 out of 41 breaking changes that can be deprecated. We have done 21 out of the 39 that can\textquotesingle{}t have deprecations. Once done, we will focus on updating the component for better following material design, and to improve the aesthetic.
\item 💄 Support extending the theme for custom color and size values in all components.
\item And many more 🐛 bug fixes and 📚 improvements.
\end{DoxyItemize}\hypertarget{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6361}{}\doxysubsection{\texorpdfstring{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+32}}{{\ttfamily @material-\/ui/core@5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+32}}}\label{md__c_1_2_users_2saket_2_one_drive_2_desktop_2e_pathshala_2epathshala-_web_2node__modules_2_0dmuab8a729db3966f628dee43470c3b1bcd_autotoc_md6361}

{\ttfamily {\itshape Feb 27, 2021}}

{\ttfamily A big thanks to the 26 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 👩‍🎤 Convert 11 components to emotion (\#24696, \#24631, \#24857, \#25048, \#24693, \#24663, \#25007, \#24688, \#24665, \#24878, \#24571) @praveenkuma @natac13 @xs9627 @povilass @m4theushw @natac13 @natac13 @\+DanailH @duganbrett @duganbrett @praveenkumar-\/kalidass @vinyldarkscratch. 75\% of the components have been migrated so far, thanks to the help of the community.
\item 🦴 Convert 4 components to the unstyled pattern (\#24985, \#24857, \#24890, \#24957) @povilass. This change doesn\textquotesingle{}t introduce any breaking changes. Hence, most of the conversion effort will be done post v5-\/stable.
\item 📚 Fix the generation of the API pages for the date pickers (\#25101, \#25100, \#25086, \#25089, \#25085, \#25084) @eps1lon. This is a follow-\/up effort after we have merged {\ttfamily material-\/ui-\/pickers}. The components are written in Type\+Script which required us to upgrade our infra.
\item 👌 Improve the Slider thumb and track animation (\#24968) @remyoudemans. The thumb is now moving with a light transition between different values unless it\textquotesingle{}s dragged. 
\item 💅 Convert 5 components with custom colors support (\#25099, \#25088) @mngu. This change makes it easier to leverage custom palettes
\item And many more 🐛 bug fixes and 📚 improvements.
\end{DoxyItemize}}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item \&\#8203;\mbox{[}icons\mbox{]} Synchronize icons (\#25055) @eps1lon

The icons were synchronized with \href{https://m2.material.io/resources/icons/}{\texttt{https\+://m2.\+material.\+io/resources/icons/}}. This change increases the number of supported icons from 1,349 to 1,781 per theme (we support 5 themes). The breaking changes\+:


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ //\ AmpStories\ -\/>\ Download}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/AmpStories}
\DoxyCodeLine{+Download}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/AmpStoriesOutlined}
\DoxyCodeLine{+DownloadOutlined}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/AmpStoriesRounded}
\DoxyCodeLine{+DownloadRounded}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/AmpStoriesSharp}
\DoxyCodeLine{+DownloadSharp}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/AmpStoriesTwoTone}
\DoxyCodeLine{+DownloadTwoTone}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ //\ Outbond\ -\/>\ Outbound}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/Outbond}
\DoxyCodeLine{+Outbound}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/OutbondOutlined}
\DoxyCodeLine{+OutboundOutlined}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/OutbondRounded}
\DoxyCodeLine{+OutboundRounded}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/OutbondSharp}
\DoxyCodeLine{+OutboundSharp}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/OutbondTwoTone}
\DoxyCodeLine{+OutboundTwoTone}

\end{DoxyCode}


We are getting closer to the maximum number of icons our infrastructure can support. In the future, we might remove the least popular icons in favor of the most frequently used ones.
\end{DoxyItemize}}

{\ttfamily {\itshape Feb 11, 2021}}

{\ttfamily A big thanks to the 30 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 👩‍🎤 Convert 32 components to emotion. Around 64\% of the components have been migrated so far, thanks to the help of the community. We aim to migrate them all before the end of Q1 2021. The podium of the most active community members in the migration 🏆\+:
\begin{DoxyEnumerate}
\item @natac13 x17
\item @vicasas x5
\item @kodai3 x4
\end{DoxyEnumerate}
\item 📐 Add a subset of MUI \+System as flattened props on {\ttfamily Typography} (\#24496) @mnajdova. Now, you can do\+:


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{<Typography\ padding=\{2\}\ color="{}text.secondary"{}\ />}

\end{DoxyCode}

\item 📅 Focus on the date pickers, 5 fixes and 3 docs improvements.
\item 💅 Provide a new \href{https://mui.com/components/css-baseline/\#scrollbars}{\texttt{{\ttfamily dark\+Scrollbar()}}} CSS utility to improve the native scrollbar in dark mode. The documentation uses it.
\end{DoxyItemize}}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item Increase the minimum version of Type\+Script supported from v3.\+2 to v3.\+5. (\#24795) @petyosi

We try to align with types released from \href{https://github.com/DefinitelyTyped/DefinitelyTyped}{\texttt{Definitely\+Typed}} (i.\+e. packages published on npm under the {\ttfamily @types} namespace). We will not change the minimum supported version in a major version of Material \+UI. However, we generally recommend to not use a Type\+Script version older than the \href{https://github.com/DefinitelyTyped/DefinitelyTyped\#older-versions-of-typescript-33-and-earlier}{\texttt{lowest supported version of Definitely\+Typed}}.
\end{DoxyItemize}}

\item \&\#8203;\mbox{[}system\mbox{]} Use spacing unit in {\ttfamily gap}, {\ttfamily row\+Gap}, and {\ttfamily column\+Gap} (\#24794) @ruppysuppy

If you were using a number previously, you need to provide the value in {\ttfamily px} to bypass the new transformation with {\ttfamily theme.\+spacing}. \begin{DoxyItemize}
\item \&\#8203;\mbox{[}types\mbox{]} Rename the exported {\ttfamily Omit} type in {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/types}. (\#24795) @petyosi The module is now called {\ttfamily Distributive\+Omit}. The change removes the confusion with the built-\/in {\ttfamily Omit} helper introduced in Type\+Script v3.\+5. The built-\/in {\ttfamily Omit}, while similar, is non-\/distributive. This leads to differences when applied to union types. \href{https://stackoverflow.com/a/57103940/1009797}{\texttt{See this Stack \+Overflow answer for further details}}.
\end{DoxyItemize}}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/import\ \{\ Omit\ \}\ from\ '@material-\/ui/types';}
\DoxyCodeLine{+import\ \{\ DistributiveOmit\ \}\ from\ '@material-\/ui/types';}

\end{DoxyCode}
}

{\ttfamily {\itshape Jan 26, 2021}}

{\ttfamily A big thanks to the 23 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 👩‍🎤 Convert 31 components to emotion. Around 40\% of the components have been migrated so far thanks to the help of the community.
\item 🐛 Fix two long-\/standing issues with the Grid. Solve the horizontal scrollbar as well as dimensions when nesting (\#24332) @greguintow.
\item 📚 Fix various display issues on API documentation pages (\#24526, \#24503, \#24504. \#24517, \#24417).
\item 📐 Add a subset of MUI \+System as flatten props on the CSS utility components ({\ttfamily Grid} and {\ttfamily Box} so far, {\ttfamily Typography} and {\ttfamily Stack} coming later) (\#24485, \#24499) @mnajdova.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{<Box\ m=\{2\}>}

{\ttfamily {\itshape Nov 23, 2020}}

{\ttfamily A big thanks to the 18 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 📚 Improve the Intelli\+Sense support for the {\ttfamily sx} prop (\#23599) @mnajdova. You should now get a description for each property of MUI \+System. For instance with {\ttfamily mx}\+:


\item 💅 Migrate the first core component to the v5 styling architecture (\#23308) @mnajdova. We have spent the last few months iterating on the new styling approach in the lab, and are confident enough in the new approach to move it to the core, so we have migrated the Slider. We will wait a week or two to collect feedback on it, before scaling it to the rest of the codebase.
\item 📅 Fix the first few issues on the date picker components since the migration in the lab.
\item And many more 🐛 bug fixes and 📚 improvements.
\end{DoxyItemize}}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item \mbox{[}Slider\mbox{]} Migrate to emotion (\#23308) @mnajdova

By default, emotion injects its style after JSS, this breaks the computed styles. In order to get the correct CSS injection order until all the components are migrated, you need to wrap the root of your application with\+:


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{import\ *\ as\ React\ from\ 'react';}
\DoxyCodeLine{import\ ReactDOM\ from\ 'react-\/dom';}
\DoxyCodeLine{import\ \{\ StylesProvider\ \}\ from\ '@material-\/ui/core';}
\DoxyCodeLine{import\ App\ from\ './App';}
\DoxyCodeLine{}
\DoxyCodeLine{ReactDOM.render(}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ <StylesProvider\ injectFirst>}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ \ <App\ />}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ </StylesProvider>,}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ document.querySelector('\#root'),}
\DoxyCodeLine{);}

\end{DoxyCode}


This enforces emotion being injected first. \href{https://mui.com/material-ui/integrations/interoperability/\#css-injection-order}{\texttt{More details}} in the documentation.
\item \mbox{[}Autocomplete\mbox{]} Rename {\ttfamily close\+Icon} prop with {\ttfamily clear\+Icon} to avoid confusion (\#23617) @akhilmhdh.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/<Autocomplete\ closeIcon=\{icon\}\ />}
\DoxyCodeLine{+<Autocomplete\ clearIcon=\{icon\}\ />}

\end{DoxyCode}

\item \mbox{[}Dialog\mbox{]} Remove the {\ttfamily disable\+Backdrop\+Click} prop. It\textquotesingle{}s redundant with the {\ttfamily reason} argument (\#23607) @eps1lon.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ <Dialog}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ disableBackdropClick}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ onClose=\{handleClose\}}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ onClose=\{(event,\ reason)\ =>\ \{}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ \ \ if\ (reason\ !==\ 'backdropClick')\ \{}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ \ \ \ \ onClose(event,\ reason);}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ \ \ \}}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ \}\}}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ />}

\end{DoxyCode}

\item \mbox{[}Modal\mbox{]} Remove the {\ttfamily disable\+Backdrop\+Click} prop. It\textquotesingle{}s redundant with the {\ttfamily reason} argument (\#23607) @eps1lon.


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ <Modal}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ disableBackdropClick}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ onClose=\{handleClose\}}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ onClose=\{(event,\ reason)\ =>\ \{}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ \ \ if\ (reason\ !==\ 'backdropClick')\ \{}

\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ \ \ \}}

\item \mbox{[}Modal\mbox{]} Remove the {\ttfamily on\+Escape\+Key\+Down} prop. It\textquotesingle{}s redundant with the {\ttfamily reason} argument. (\#23571) @eps1lon

{\ttfamily {\itshape Nov 14, 2020}}

{\ttfamily A big thanks to the 34 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 📅 Migrate the date picker to the lab (\#22692) @dmtr\+Kovalenko. We have integrated the components with the code infrastructure. Next we will migrate all the Git\+Hub issues from \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui-pickers}{\texttt{material-\/ui-\/pickers}} and archive the repository. This migration will help provide first-\/class support for the date picker components. The component will stay in the lab as long as necessary to reach the high-\/quality bar we have for core components. You can find the \href{https://mui.com/components/pickers/}{\texttt{new documentation here}}.

While the source code is currently hosted in the \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui}{\texttt{main repository}}, we might move it to the \href{https://github.com/mui/mui-x}{\texttt{x repository}} in the future, depending on what is easier for the commercial date range picker. The date picker will stay open source no matter what.
\item 📚 Revamp the documentation for \href{https://mui.com/system/getting-started/}{\texttt{MUI \+System}}. The System contains CSS utilities. The documentation now promotes the use of the {\ttfamily sx} prop. It\textquotesingle{}s ideal for adding one-\/off styles, for example padding, but when pushed to its limits, it can be used to implement quickly a complete page.
\item 👩‍🎨 Upgrade emotion to v11 (\#23007) @mnajdova.
\item And many more 🐛 bug fixes and 📚 improvements.
\end{DoxyItemize}}

{\ttfamily {\itshape Nov 4, 2020}}

{\ttfamily A big thanks to the 20 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item ⚛️ Add support for React 17 (\#23311) @eps1lon. React 17 release is unusual because it doesn\textquotesingle{}t add any new developer-\/facing features. It was released a couple of days ago. You can learn more about it in the \href{https://legacy.reactjs.org/blog/2020/10/20/react-v17.html}{\texttt{introduction post}}. Material \+UI now supports {\ttfamily \texorpdfstring{$^\wedge$}{\string^}16.8.\+0 \texorpdfstring{$\vert$}{|}\texorpdfstring{$\vert$}{|} \texorpdfstring{$^\wedge$}{\string^}17.0.\+0}.
\item 🛠 Introduce a new {\ttfamily @material-\/ui/unstyled} package (\#23270) @mnajdova. This package will host the unstyled version of the components. In this first iteration, only the Slider is available. You can find it documented under the \href{https://mui.com/components/slider-styled/\#unstyled-slider}{\texttt{same page}} as the styled version.

{\bfseries{Why an unstyled package?}}

While engineering teams are successfully building custom design systems by wrapping Material \+UI, we \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/issues/6218}{\texttt{occasionally hear}} that Material Design or our styling solution are something they don\textquotesingle{}t need. Some teams prefer SASS, others prefer to customize the components starting from a pristine state. What all these teams have in common is that they value the features coming from the components, such as accessibility.

The unstyled package goes one step down in the abstraction layer, providing more flexibility. Angular Material introduced this approach two years ago. Today their unstyled components account for \href{https://npm-stat.com/charts.html?package=\%40angular\%2Fmaterial&package=\%40angular\%2Fcdk&from=2017-11-03&to=2020-11-03}{\texttt{25\% of the usage}}.

Another reason for introducing this package is to prepare the groundwork for a \href{https://github.com/mui/material-ui/issues/22485}{\texttt{second theme}} (not Material Design based).

A note on the terminology\+: "{}unstyled"{} means that the components have the same API as the "{}styled"{} components but come without CSS. Material \+UI also contains "{}headless"{} components that exposes a hook API, for example \href{https://mui.com/components/autocomplete/\#useautocomplete}{\texttt{use\+Autocomplete}} or \href{https://mui.com/components/pagination/\#usepagination}{\texttt{use\+Pagination}}.

This change is part of our strategy to iterate on the v5 architecture with the {\ttfamily Slider} first. In the next alpha release, we plan to replace the v4 slider with the v5 slider. Once the new approach is stress-\/tested and validated, we will roll it out to all the components.
\item And many more 🐛 bug fixes and 📚 improvements.
\end{DoxyItemize}}

{\ttfamily {\itshape Oct 23, 2020}}

{\ttfamily A big thanks to the 23 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 💄 Introduce a new {\ttfamily sx} prop (\#23053, \#23205) @mnajdova We have resumed the work on Material \+UI System. This is made possible by the latest progress on the new styling solution of v5. You can read the \href{https://medium.com/material-ui/introducing-material-ui-design-system-93e921beb8df}{\texttt{introduction blog post}} that we did for MUI \+System two years ago.

The system is meant to solve the following problems\+:
\begin{DoxyEnumerate}
\item Naming things is hard. How should a class name, JSS style rule, or styled component be named?
\item Jumping between JS and CSS in the editor wastes time. This is particularly true as the complexity (LOCs/\# of elements) of a component increases. It\textquotesingle{}s still true when using the {\ttfamily styled()} API.
\item Introducing a {\ttfamily make\+Styles} for the first time in a component is daunting. For example, it\textquotesingle{}s why \href{https://github.com/vscodeshift/material-ui-codemorphs\#add-usestyles-hook}{\texttt{https\+://github.\+com/vscodeshift/material-\/ui-\/codemorphs\#add-\/usestyles-\/hook}} exists. What if we had less code to type, gaining velocity when writing styles?
\item Pulling values out from the theme can be cumbersome. How can we make it less painful to increase the usage of design tokens?
\end{DoxyEnumerate}

This new iteration of MUI \+System brings two major improvements\+:
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item It moves from the support of a subset of CSS to the support of a superset of CSS. Learning the shorthand is optional. It\textquotesingle{}s no longer necessary to moving back to styled() when MUI \+System doesn\textquotesingle{}t support a specific CSS property.
\item It moves from support on Box only to any core component (starting with the slider).

\`{}\`{}`jsx import Slider from '@material-\/ui/lab/\+Slider\+Styled\textquotesingle{};

// Set the primary color and a vertical margin of 16px on desktop. \texorpdfstring{$<$}{<}Slider sx=\{\{ color\+: \textquotesingle{}primary.\+main\textquotesingle{}, my\+: \{ xs\+: 0, md\+: 2 \} \}\} /\texorpdfstring{$>$}{>}; \`{}\`{}\`{}
\end{DoxyItemize}
\item ✨ Upgrade Popper.\+js from v1 to v2 (\#21761) @joshwooding The change reduces the bundle size (-\/1 kB gzipped) while fixing bugs at the same time.
\item 🐛 Fix broken nested imports with the icons package (\#23157) @eps1lon The revamp of the bundling strategy in \#22814 has broken the nested imports. Imports such as the one below should work again with this release\+:


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{import\ CloseIcon\ from\ '@material-\/ui/icons/Close';}

\end{DoxyCode}

\item And many more 🐛 bug fixes and 📚 improvements.
\end{DoxyItemize}}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item \mbox{[}Popper\mbox{]} Upgrade to popper.\+js to v2 (\#21761) @joshwooding This third-\/party library has introduced a lot of changes.~\newline
 You can read \href{https://popper.js.org/docs/v2/migration-guide/}{\texttt{their migration guide}} or the following summary\+:
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item The CSS prefixes have changed\+:


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ popper:\ \{}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ zIndex:\ 1,}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ '\&[x-\/placement*="{}bottom"{}]\ \$arrow':\ \{}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ '\&[data-\/popper-\/placement*="{}bottom"{}]\ \$arrow':\ \{}

\end{DoxyCode}

\item Method names have changed.

{\ttfamily diff -\/popper\+Ref.\+current.\+schedule\+Update() +popper\+Ref.\+current.\+update() }

{\ttfamily diff -\/popper\+Ref.\+current.\+update() +popper\+Ref.\+current.\+force\+Update() }
\item Modifiers\textquotesingle{} API has changed a lot. There are too many changes to be covered here.
\end{DoxyItemize}
\item \mbox{[}with\+Mobile\+Dialog\mbox{]} Remove this higher-\/order component (\#23202) @\+RDIL The hook API allows a simpler and more flexible solution than the HOC\+:


\begin{DoxyCode}{0}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/import\ withMobileDialog\ from\ '@material-\/ui/core/withMobileDialog';}
\DoxyCodeLine{+import\ \{ useTheme,\ useMediaQuery\ \}\ from\ '@material-\/ui/core';}
\DoxyCodeLine{}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ function\ ResponsiveDialog(props)\ \{}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/\ \ const\ \{\ fullScreen\ \}\ =\ props;}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ const\ theme\ =\ useTheme();}
\DoxyCodeLine{+\ \ const\ fullScreen\ =\ useMediaQuery(theme.breakpoints.down('sm'));}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ \ \ const\ [open,\ setOpen]\ =\ React.useState(false);}
\DoxyCodeLine{}
\DoxyCodeLine{\ //\ ...}
\DoxyCodeLine{}
\DoxyCodeLine{-\/export\ default\ withMobileDialog()(ResponsiveDialog);}
\DoxyCodeLine{+export\ default\ ResponsiveDialog;}

\end{DoxyCode}

\end{DoxyItemize}}

{\ttfamily {\itshape Oct 17, 2020}}

{\ttfamily A big thanks to the 25 contributors who made this release possible. Here are some highlights ✨\+:}

{\ttfamily 
\begin{DoxyItemize}
\item 📦 Ship modern bundle (\#22814) @eps1lon. This is a significant update to the \href{https://mui.com/material-ui/getting-started/supported-platforms/}{\texttt{browsers supported}} by Material \+UI. The previous policy was defined 2 years ago, and the landscape has evolved since then. The package now includes 4 bundles\+:
\begin{DoxyEnumerate}
\item {\ttfamily stable} (default, formerly {\ttfamily esm}) which targets a snapshot (on release) of {\ttfamily \texorpdfstring{$>$}{>} 0.\+5\%, last 2 versions, Firefox ESR, not dead, not IE 11"{}$<$/tt$>$   2. $<$tt$>$node$<$/tt$>$ (formerly default) which targets a snapshot (on release) of $<$tt$>$maintained node versions$<$/tt$>$   3. $<$tt$>$legacy$<$/tt$>$ (new) which is $<$tt$>$stable$<$/tt$>$ + IE11   4. $<$tt$>$modern$<$/tt$>$ (formerly $<$tt$>$es$<$/tt$>$) which targets the last 1 version of evergreen browsers and active node (currently that is 14    The change yields a 6\% reduction in bundle size 📦 (\+Babel only).   In the coming weeks, we will refactor the internals to take advantage of the new browser capabilities that dropping these older platforms allows. For instance, we might be able to remove the span we render inside the $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}$<$\+Button\textbackslash{}$>$$<$/tt$>$ to work around $<$a href="{}\href{https://github.com/philipwalton/flexbugs/blob/master/README.md\#flexbug-9}{\texttt{https\+://github.\+com/philipwalton/flexbugs/blob/master/\+README.\+md\#flexbug-\/9}}"{} $>$\+Flexbug \#9$<$/a$>$.    Check the updated $<$a href="{}\href{https://mui.com/material-ui/getting-started/supported-platforms/}{\texttt{https\+://mui.\+com/material-\/ui/getting-\/started/supported-\/platforms/}}"{} $>$\+Supported platforms documentation$<$/a$>$ and $<$a href="{}\href{https://mui.com/material-ui/guides/minimizing-bundle-size/}{\texttt{https\+://mui.\+com/material-\/ui/guides/minimizing-\/bundle-\/size/}}"{} $>$new "{}minimizing bundle size"{} guide$<$/a$>$.    If you target IE11, you need to use the new bundle ($<$tt$>$legacy$<$/tt$>$). We are treating IE11 as a second class-\/citizen, which is a continuation of the direction taken in \#22873.  -\/ 🚀 Improve the internal benchmark suite (\#22923, \#23058) @mnajdova.   This was a prerequisite step to improve the $<$a href="{}\href{https://mui.com/system/getting-started/}{\texttt{https\+://mui.\+com/system/getting-\/started/}}"{} $>$system$<$/a$>$. We needed to be able to measure performance. After \#22945, we have measured that the $<$tt$>$\+Box$<$/tt$>$ component is x3 faster in v5-\/alpha compared to v4. -\/ ✏️ A new blog post\+: $<$a cleanup (\#22983) @eps1lon  @section autotoc\+\_\+md6557 5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+12  $<$em$>$\+Oct 11, 2020$<$/em$>$  \+A big thanks to the 45 contributors who made this release possible. \+Here are some highlights ✨\+:  -\/ 🧪 The promotion of 4 components from the lab to core\+: Autocomplete, Pagination, Speed\+Dial, and Toggle\+Button. These components have been in the lab for more than 10 months @mbrookes. -\/ 📦 Switch the style engine of the $<$tt$>$\+Box$<$/tt$>$ component from JSS to $<$em$>$@material-\/ui/styled-\/engine$<$/em$>$ (use emotion by default) (\#22945) @mnajdova.   The early benchmark we have run shows that performance has improved. We will share more detailed results in \#21657. -\/ 🐙 Migrate a large portion of the tests from enzyme to react-\/testing-\/library @eladmotola, @baterson, @bewong89, @devrasec, @guillermaster, @itamar244, @jeferson-\/sb, @\+The24th\+DS.   Last month, react-\/testing-\/library had $<$a href="{}\href{https://npm-stat.com/charts.html?package=enzyme&package=\%40testing-library\%2Freact&from=2019-10-10&to=2020-10-10}{\texttt{https\+://npm-\/stat.\+com/charts.\+html?package=enzyme\&package=\%40testing-\/library\%2\+Freact\&from=2019-\/10-\/10\&to=2020-\/10-\/10}}"{} $>$more downloads$<$/a$>$ than enzyme in the ecosystem! -\/ 🏷 Add support for tooltips $<$a href="{}\href{https://mui.com/components/tooltips/\#follow-cursor}{\texttt{https\+://mui.\+com/components/tooltips/\#follow-\/cursor}}"{} $>$following the cursor$<$/a$>$ (\#22876) @xtrixia. -\/ And many more 🐛 bug fixes and 📚 improvements.  @subsection autotoc\+\_\+md6558 $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}@material-\/ui/core\textbackslash{}@v5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+12$<$/tt$>$  @subsubsection autotoc\+\_\+md6559 Breaking changes  -\/ \mbox{[}\+Accordion\mbox{]} Remove $<$tt$>$display\+:flex$<$/tt$>$ from Accordion\+Details (\#22809) @croraf   The style was too opinionated. Most developers expect $<$tt$>$display\+: block$<$/tt$>$. -\/ \mbox{[}\+Accordion\mbox{]} Replace Icon\+Button wrapper with div (\#22817) @croraf   Remove Icon\+Button\+Props prop from Accordion\+Summary.   The component renders a $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}$<$div\textbackslash{}$>$$<$/tt$>$ element instead of an Icon\+Button.   The prop is no longer relevant. -\/ \mbox{[}\+Box\mbox{]} Add mui styled usage (\#22945) @mnajdova   Change the style-\/engine powering the Box component from JSS to the style engine adatper (emotion by default). -\/ \mbox{[}\+Circular\+Progress\mbox{]} Drop IE11 wobbly workaround (\#22873) @suliskh   The IE11 workaround is harming performance on the latest browsers.   This change is part of a best-\/effort strategy to keep IE11 support.   We are degrading the UX and DX with IE11 where we can improve the components on modern browsers. -\/ \mbox{[}\+Table\mbox{]} Rename on\+Change\+Rows\+Per\+Page and on\+Change\+Page (\#22900) @eladmotola   The change was done to match the API convention.    @icode\{diff\}     $<$\+Table\+Pagination   -\/  on\+Change\+Rows\+Per\+Page=\{()=$>$\{\}\}   -\/  on\+Change\+Page=\{()=$>$\{\}\}   +  on\+Rows\+Per\+Page\+Change=\{()=$>$\{\}\}   +  on\+Page\+Change=\{()=$>$\{\}\}   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}theme\mbox{]} Rename fade to alpha (\#22834) @mnajdova   Better describe its functionality. The previous name was leading to confusion when the input color already had an alpha value. The helper $<$strong$>$overrides$<$/strong$>$ the alpha value of the color.    @icode\{diff\}    -\/import \{ fade \} from \textquotesingle{}@material-\/ui/core/styles\textquotesingle{};   +import \{ alpha \} from \textquotesingle{}@material-\/ui/core/styles\textquotesingle{};     const classes = make\+Styles(theme =$>$ (\{   -\/  background\+Color\+: fade(theme.\+palette.\+primary.\+main, theme.\+palette.\+action.\+selected\+Opacity),   +  background\+Color\+: alpha(theme.\+palette.\+primary.\+main, theme.\+palette.\+action.\+selected\+Opacity),    \}));   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}\+Tooltip\mbox{]} Make $<$tt$>$interactive$<$/tt$>$ default (\#22382) @eps1lon   The previous default behavior failed $<$a href="{}\href{https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG21/\#content-on-hover-or-focus}{\texttt{https\+://www.\+w3.\+org/\+TR/\+WCAG21/\#content-\/on-\/hover-\/or-\/focus}}"{} $>$success criterion 1.\+4.\+3 ("{}hoverable"{}) in WCAG 2.\+1$<$/a$>$.   To reflect the new default value, the prop was renamed to $<$tt$>$disable\+Interactive$<$/tt$>$.   If you want to restore the old behavior (thus not reaching level AA), you can apply the following diff\+:    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Tooltip$>$   +$<$\+Tooltip disable\+Interactive$>$    \# \mbox{[}test\mbox{]} Verbose reporter in CI (\#22924) @eps1lon  @section autotoc\+\_\+md6567 5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+11  $<$em$>$\+Sep 26, 2020$<$/em$>$  \+A big thanks to the 29 contributors who made this release possible. \+Here are some highlights ✨\+:  -\/ 👩‍🎨 A first iteration on the new styling solution.    You can find a $<$a href="{}\href{https://mui.com/components/slider-styled/}{\texttt{https\+://mui.\+com/components/slider-\/styled/}}"{} $>$new version$<$/a$>$ of the slider in the lab powered by $<$a href="{}\href{https://emotion.sh/}{\texttt{https\+://emotion.\+sh/}}"{} $>$\+Emotion$<$/a$>$.    In the event that you are already using styled-\/components in your application, you can swap emotion for styled-\/components 💅. Check $<$a href="{}\href{https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/sliderstyled-with-styled-components-forked-olc27?file=/package.json}{\texttt{https\+://codesandbox.\+io/p/sandbox/sliderstyled-\/with-\/styled-\/components-\/forked-\/olc27?file=/package.\+json}}"{} $>$this Code\+Sandbox$<$/a$>$ for a demo. It relies on aliases to prevent any bundle size overhead.    The new styling solution saves 2k\+B gzipped in the bundle compared to JSS, and about 14 k\+B gzipped if you were already using emotion or styled-\/components.    Last but not least, the change allows us to take advantage dynamic style props. We will use them for dynamic color props, variant props, and new style props (an improved $<$a href="{}\href{https://mui.com/system/getting-started/}{\texttt{https\+://mui.\+com/system/getting-\/started/}}"{} $>$system$<$/a$>$).    This change has been in our roadmap for more than a year.   We announced it in the $<$a href="{}\href{https://mui.com/blog/material-ui-v4-is-out/}{\texttt{https\+://mui.\+com/blog/material-\/ui-\/v4-\/is-\/out/}}"{} $>$v4 release blog post$<$/a$>$ as a direction v5 would take.  -\/ 🛠 A first iteration on the unstyled components.    You can find a $<$a href="{}\href{https://mui.com/components/slider-styled/\#UnstyledSlider.tsx}{\texttt{https\+://mui.\+com/components/slider-\/styled/\#\+Unstyled\+Slider.\+tsx}}"{} $>$new version$<$/a$>$ of the slider in the lab without any styles.   The unstyled component weighs 6.\+5 k\+B gzipped, compared with 26 k\+B for the styled version when used standalone. The component is best suited for use when you want to fully customize the look of the component without reimplementing the Java\+Script and accessibility logic.  -\/ ⚡️ A first alpha of the $<$a href="{}\href{https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/}{\texttt{https\+://mui.\+com/x/react-\/data-\/grid/}}"{} $>$\+Data\+Grid$<$/a$>$ component.    It has taken 6 months of development since the initial commit (\+March 15th, 2020) to make the first alpha release of the grid. The component comes in two versions\+:   @material-\/ui/data-\/grid is licensed under MIT, while @material-\/ui/x-\/grid is licensed under a commercial license.  -\/ 🪓 Keep working on the breaking changes.    We aim to complete most of the breaking changes during the alpha stage of v5.   We will move to beta once all the breaking changes we have anticipated are handled.   As always, you should find a clear and simple upgrade path for each of them.   You can learn more about the breaking changes left to be done in \#22700.  -\/ And many more 🐛 bug fixes and 📚 improvements.  @subsection autotoc\+\_\+md6568 $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}@material-\/ui/core\textbackslash{}@v5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+11$<$/tt$>$  @subsubsection autotoc\+\_\+md6569 Breaking changes  -\/ \mbox{[}\+Chip\mbox{]} Rename $<$tt$>$default$<$/tt$>$ variant to $<$tt$>$filled$<$/tt$>$ (\#22683) @mnajdova   Rename $<$tt$>$default$<$/tt$>$ variant to $<$tt$>$filled$<$/tt$>$ for consistency.    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Chip variant="{}default"{}$>$   +$<$\+Chip variant="{}filled"{}$>$   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}\+Tabs\mbox{]} Add allow\+Scroll\+Buttons\+Mobile prop for mobile view (\#22700) @\+Gaurav\+Kesarwani   The API that controls the scroll buttons has been split it into two props\+:    -\/ The $<$tt$>$scroll\+Buttons$<$/tt$>$ prop controls when the scroll buttons are displayed depending on the space available.   -\/ The $<$tt$>$allow\+Scroll\+Buttons\+Mobile$<$/tt$>$ prop removes the CSS media query that systematically hides the scroll buttons on mobile.    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Tabs scroll\+Buttons="{}on"{} /$>$   -\/$<$\+Tabs scroll\+Buttons="{}desktop"{} /$>$   -\/$<$\+Tabs scroll\+Buttons="{}off"{} /$>$   +$<$\+Tabs scroll\+Buttons allow\+Scroll\+Buttons\+Mobile /$>$   +$<$\+Tabs scroll\+Buttons /$>$   +$<$\+Tabs scroll\+Buttons=\{false\} /$>$   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}theme\mbox{]} Improve breakpoints definitions (\#22695) @mnajdova   Breakpoints are now treated as values instead of ranges.   The behavior of $<$tt$>$down(key)$<$/tt$>$ was changed to define media query less than the value defined with the corresponding breakpoint (exclusive).   The behavior of $<$tt$>$between(start, end)$<$/tt$>$ was also updated to define media query for the values between the actual values of start (inclusive) and end (exclusive). 5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+6  $<$em$>$\+Aug 13, 2020$<$/em$>$  \+A big thanks to the 26 contributors who made this release possible. \+Here are some highlights ✨\+:  -\/ 💅 Introduce a new dynamic variant API (\#21648) @mnajdova.   This API allows developers to add new variants on the Material \+UI\textquotesingle{}s components right from the theme, without having to wrap the components.   For instance with the Button\+:    @icode\{tsx\}    // Define the style that should be applied, for specific props.   const theme = create\+Mui\+Theme(\{     variants\+: \{       Mui\+Button\+: \mbox{[}         \{           props\+: \{ variant\+: \textquotesingle{}dashed\textquotesingle{}, color\+: \textquotesingle{}secondary\textquotesingle{} \},           styles\+: \{             border\+: \`{}4px dashed \$\{red\mbox{[}500\mbox{]}\}\`{},           \},         \},       \mbox{]},     \},   \});    // Retain type safety.   declare module \textquotesingle{}@material-\/ui/core/\+Button/\+Button\textquotesingle{} \{     interface Button\+Props\+Variant\+Overrides \{       dashed\+: true;     \}   \}    // Enjoy!   $<$\+Button variant="{}dashed"{} /$>$;   @endicode     More details in $<$a href="{}\href{https://mui.com/material-ui/customization/components/\#adding-new-component-variants}{\texttt{https\+://mui.\+com/material-\/ui/customization/components/\#adding-\/new-\/component-\/variants}}"{} $>$the documentation$<$/a$>$ and @ref "{}21749"{} "{}RFC"{}.  -\/ 👮 Add documentation for the $<$a href="{}\href{https://mui.com/base-ui/react-focus-trap/}{\texttt{https\+://mui.\+com/base-\/ui/react-\/focus-\/trap/}}"{} $>$\+Focus\+Trap$<$/a$>$ component (\#22062) @oliviertassinari. -\/ ⚛️ Prepare support for React v17 (\#22093, \#22105, \#22143, \#22111) @eps1lon. -\/ 🚧 We have undertaken breaking changes.  @subsection autotoc\+\_\+md6616 $<$tt$>$\textbackslash{}@material-\/ui/core\textbackslash{}@v5.\+0.\+0-\/alpha.\+6$<$/tt$>$  @subsubsection autotoc\+\_\+md6617 Breaking changes  -\/ \mbox{[}\+Avatar\mbox{]} Rename variant circle -\/$>$ circular for consistency (\#22015) @kodai3   Rename $<$tt$>$circle$<$/tt$>$ to $<$tt$>$circular$<$/tt$>$ for consistency. The possible values should be adjectives, not nouns\+:    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Avatar variant="{}circle"{}$>$   +$<$\+Avatar variant="{}circular"{}$>$   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}\+Badge\mbox{]} Rename overlap circle -\/$>$ circular and rectangle -\/$>$ rectangular for consistency (\#22050) @kodai3   Rename $<$tt$>$circle$<$/tt$>$ to $<$tt$>$circular$<$/tt$>$ and $<$tt$>$rectangle$<$/tt$>$ to $<$tt$>$rectangular$<$/tt$>$ for consistency. The possible values should be adjectives, not nouns\+:    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Badge overlap="{}circle"{}$>$   -\/$<$\+Badge overlap="{}rectangle"{}$>$   +$<$\+Badge overlap="{}circular"{}$>$   +$<$\+Badge overlap="{}rectangular"{}$>$   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}\+Circular\+Progress\mbox{]} Remove static variant, simplify determinate (\#22060) @mbrookes   The $<$tt$>$static$<$/tt$>$ variant has been merged into the $<$tt$>$determinate$<$/tt$>$ variant, with the latter assuming the appearance of the former.   The removed variant was rarely useful. It was an exception to Material Design, and was removed from the specification.    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Circular\+Progress variant="{}determinate"{} /$>$   @endicode     @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Circular\+Progress variant="{}static"{} classes=\{\{ static\+: \textquotesingle{}class\+Name\textquotesingle{} \}\} /$>$   +$<$\+Circular\+Progress variant="{}determinate"{} classes=\{\{ determinate\+: \textquotesingle{}class\+Name\textquotesingle{} \}\} /$>$   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}\+Dialog\mbox{]} Remove transition on\+X props (\#22113) @mbrookes   The on\+E\texorpdfstring{$\ast$}{*} transition props were removed. Use Transition\+Props instead.    @icode\{diff\}     $<$\+Dialog   -\/  on\+Enter=\{on\+Enter\}   -\/  on\+Entered=\{on\+Entered\},   -\/  on\+Entering=\{on\+Entered\},   -\/  on\+Exit=\{on\+Entered\},   -\/  on\+Exited=\{on\+Entered\},   -\/  on\+Exiting=\{on\+Entered\}   +  Transition\+Props=\{\{   +    on\+Enter,   +    on\+Entered,   +    on\+Entering,   +    on\+Exit,   +    on\+Exited,   +    on\+Exiting,   +  \}\}    /$>$   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}\+Fab\mbox{]} Rename round -\/$>$ circular for consistency (\#21903) @kodai3   Rename $<$tt$>$round$<$/tt$>$ to $<$tt$>$circular$<$/tt$>$ for consistency. The possible values should be adjectives, not nouns\+:    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Fab variant="{}round"{}$>$   +$<$\+Fab variant="{}circular"{}$>$   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}\+List\mbox{]} Improve hover/select/focus UI display (\#21930) @joshwooding -\/ \mbox{[}\+Pagination\mbox{]} Rename round -\/$>$ circular for consistency (\#22009) @kodai3   Rename $<$tt$>$round$<$/tt$>$ to $<$tt$>$circular$<$/tt$>$ for consistency. The possible values should be adjectives, not nouns\+:    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Pagination shape="{}round"{}$>$   -\/$<$\+Pagination\+Item shape="{}round"{}$>$   +$<$\+Pagination shape="{}circular"{}$>$   +$<$\+Pagination\+Item shape="{}circular"{}$>$   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}\+Root\+Ref\mbox{]} Remove component (\#21974) @eps1lon   This component was removed. You can get a reference to the underlying DOM node of our components via $<$tt$>$ref$<$/tt$>$ prop.   The component relied on $<$a href="{}\href{https://legacy.reactjs.org/docs/react-dom.html\#finddomnode}{\texttt{https\+://legacy.\+reactjs.\+org/docs/react-\/dom.\+html\#finddomnode}}"{} $>$$<$tt$>$\+React\+DOM.\+find\+DOMNode$<$/tt$>$$<$/a$>$ which is $<$a href="{}\href{https://legacy.reactjs.org/docs/strict-mode.html\#warning-about-deprecated-finddomnode-usage}{\texttt{https\+://legacy.\+reactjs.\+org/docs/strict-\/mode.\+html\#warning-\/about-\/deprecated-\/finddomnode-\/usage}}"{} $>$deprecated in $<$tt$>$\+React.\+Strict\+Mode$<$/tt$>$$<$/a$>$.    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Root\+Ref root\+Ref=\{ref\}$>$   -\/  $<$\+Button /$>$   -\/$<$/\+Root\+Ref$>$   +$<$\+Button ref=\{ref\} /$>$   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}\+Snackbar\mbox{]} Change the default position on desktop (\#21980) @kodai3   The notification now displays at the bottom left on large screens.   It better matches the behavior of Gmail, Google Keep, material.\+io, etc.   You can restore the previous behavior with\+:    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Snackbar /$>$   +$<$\+Snackbar anchor\+Origin=\{\{ vertical\+: \textquotesingle{}bottom\textquotesingle{}, horizontal\+: \textquotesingle{}center\textquotesingle{} \}\} /$>$   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}\+Snackbar\mbox{]} Remove transition on\+X props (\#22107) @mbrookes   The on\+E\texorpdfstring{$\ast$}{*} transition props were removed. Use Transition\+Props instead.    @icode\{diff\}     $<$\+Snackbar   -\/  on\+Enter=\{on\+Enter\}   -\/  on\+Entered=\{on\+Entered\},   -\/  on\+Entering=\{on\+Entered\},   -\/  on\+Exit=\{on\+Entered\},   -\/  on\+Exited=\{on\+Entered\},   -\/  on\+Exiting=\{on\+Entered\}   +  Transition\+Props=\{\{   +    on\+Enter,   +    on\+Entered,   +    on\+Entering,   +    on\+Exit,   +    on\+Exited,   +    on\+Exiting,   +  \}\}    /$>$   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}\+Textarea\+Autosize\mbox{]} Rename rows\+Max-\/$>$max\+Rows \& rows\+Min-\/$>$min\+Rows (\#21873) @mhayk   Rename $<$tt$>$rows\+Min$<$/tt$>$/$<$tt$>$rows\+Max$<$/tt$>$ prop with $<$tt$>$mi Rows$<$/tt$>$/$<$tt$>$max\+Rows$<$/tt$>$ for consistency with HTML attributes.    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Text\+Field rows\+Max=\{6\}$>$   -\/$<$\+Textare\+Autosize rows\+Min=\{1\}$>$   -\/$<$\+Textare\+Autosize rows\+Max=\{6\}$>$   +$<$\+Text\+Field max\+Rows=\{6\}$>$   +$<$\+Textare\+Autosize min\+Rows=\{1\}$>$   +$<$\+Textare\+Autosize max\+Rows=\{6\}$>$   @endicode   -\/ \mbox{[}\+Text\+Field\mbox{]} Better isolate static textarea behavior to dynamic one (\#21995) @\+Axart\+Inc   Better isolate the fixed textarea height behavior to the dynamic one.   You need to use the $<$tt$>$rows\+Min$<$/tt$>$ prop in the following case\+:    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Text\+Field rows=\{2\} rows\+Max=\{5\} /$>$   +$<$\+Text\+Field rows\+Min=\{2\} rows\+Max=\{5\} /$>$   @endicode     Remove the $<$tt$>$rows$<$/tt$>$ prop, use the $<$tt$>$rows\+Min$<$/tt$>$ prop instead.   This change aims to clarify the behavior of the prop.    @icode\{diff\}    -\/$<$\+Textarea\+Autosize rows=\{2\} /$>$   +$<$\+Textarea\+Autosize rows\+Min=\{2\} /$>$   @endicode   -\/
